description: Gets information about an AWS CloudFormation stack.

parameters.name: access_key
parameters.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_ACCESS_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The aws_access_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_access_key_id alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: all_facts
parameters.description: Get all stack information for the stack. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: aws_ca_bundle
parameters.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: aws_config
parameters.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config.

parameters.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
parameters.description: Use a botocore.endpoint logger to parse the unique (rather than total) "resource:action" API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the aws_resource_action callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS environment variable may also be used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: endpoint_url
parameters.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints. While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The AWS_URL environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html. The AWS_PROFILE environment variable may also be used. The profile option is mutually exclusive with the aws_access_key, aws_secret_key and session_token options.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, region is ignored. The AWS_REGION environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region.

parameters.name: secret_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_SECRET_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The secret_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_secret_access_key alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable may also be used. The session_token and profile options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: stack_change_sets
parameters.description: Get stack change sets for the stack Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: stack_events
parameters.description: Get stack events for the stack. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: stack_name
parameters.description: The name or id of the CloudFormation stack. Gathers information on all stacks by default.

parameters.name: stack_policy
parameters.description: Get stack policy for the stack. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: stack_resources
parameters.description: Get stack resources for the stack. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: stack_template
parameters.description: Get stack template body for the stack. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting validate_certs=false is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting aws_ca_bundle instead. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
# Note: These examples do not set authentication details, see the AWS Guide for details.

- name: Get information on all stacks
  amazon.aws.cloudformation_info:
  register: all_stacks_output

- name: Get summary information about a stack
  amazon.aws.cloudformation_info:
    stack_name: my-cloudformation-stack
  register: output

- debug:
    msg: "{{ output['cloudformation']['my-cloudformation-stack'] }}"

# Get stack outputs, when you have the stack name available as a fact
- set_fact:
    stack_name: my-awesome-stack

- amazon.aws.cloudformation_info:
    stack_name: "{{ stack_name }}"
  register: my_stack

- debug:
    msg: "{{ my_stack.cloudformation[stack_name].stack_outputs }}"

# Get all stack information about a stack
- amazon.aws.cloudformation_info:
    stack_name: my-cloudformation-stack
    all_facts: true

# Get stack resource and stack policy information about a stack
- amazon.aws.cloudformation_info:
    stack_name: my-cloudformation-stack
    stack_resources: true
    stack_policy: true

# Fail if the stack doesn't exist
- name: try to get info about a stack but fail if it doesn't exist
  amazon.aws.cloudformation_info:
    stack_name: nonexistent-stack
    all_facts: true
  failed_when: cloudformation['nonexistent-stack'] is undefined

return_values.name: cloudformation
return_values.description: Dictionary of dictionaries containing info of stack(s). Keys are stack_name(s). Returned: always

return_values.name: stack_change_sets
return_values.description: A list of stack change sets. Each item in the list represents the details of a specific changeset. Returned: only if all_facts or stack_policy is true and the stack exists

return_values.name: stack_description
return_values.description: Summary facts about the stack. Returned: if the stack exists

return_values.name: capabilities
return_values.description: The capabilities allowed in the stack. Returned: always

return_values.name: creation_time
return_values.description: The time at which the stack was created. Returned: if stack exists

return_values.name: deletion_time
return_values.description: The time at which the stack was deleted. Returned: if stack was deleted

return_values.name: description
return_values.description: The user-defined description associated with the stack. Returned: always

return_values.name: disable_rollback
return_values.description: Whether or not rollback on stack creation failures is enabled. Returned: always

return_values.name: drift_information
return_values.description: Information about whether a stack’s actual configuration differs, or has drifted, from it’s expected configuration, as defined in the stack template and any values specified as template parameters. Returned: always

return_values.name: last_check_timestamp
return_values.description: Most recent time when a drift detection operation was initiated on the stack, or any of its individual resources that support drift detection. Returned: if a drift was detected

return_values.name: stack_drift_status
return_values.description: Status of the stack’s actual configuration compared to its expected template configuration. Returned: always

return_values.name: enable_termination_protection
return_values.description: Whether termination protection is enabled for the stack. Returned: always

return_values.name: notification_arns
return_values.description: Amazon SNS topic ARNs to which stack related events are published. Returned: always

return_values.name: outputs
return_values.description: A list of output dicts. Returned: always

return_values.name: output_key
return_values.description: The key associated with the output. Returned: always

return_values.name: output_value
return_values.description: The value associated with the output. Returned: always

return_values.name: parameters
return_values.description: A list of parameter dicts. Returned: always

return_values.name: parameter_key
return_values.description: The key associated with the parameter. Returned: always

return_values.name: parameter_value
return_values.description: The value associated with the parameter. Returned: always

return_values.name: rollback_configuration
return_values.description: The rollback triggers for CloudFormation to monitor during stack creation and updating operations. Returned: always

return_values.name: rollback_triggers
return_values.description: The triggers to monitor during stack creation or update actions. Returned: when rollback triggers exist

return_values.name: arn
return_values.description: The ARN of the rollback trigger. Returned: always

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: The resource type of the rollback trigger. Returned: always

return_values.name: stack_id
return_values.description: The unique ID of the stack. Returned: always

return_values.name: stack_name
return_values.description: The name of the stack. Returned: always

return_values.name: stack_status
return_values.description: The status of the stack. Returned: always

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: A list of tags associated with the stack. Returned: always

return_values.name: key
return_values.description: Key of tag. Returned: always

return_values.name: value
return_values.description: Value of tag. Returned: always

return_values.name: stack_events
return_values.description: All stack events for the stack. Returned: only if all_facts or stack_events is true and the stack exists

return_values.name: stack_outputs
return_values.description: Dictionary of stack outputs keyed by the value of each output ‘OutputKey’ parameter and corresponding value of each output ‘OutputValue’ parameter. Returned: if the stack exists Sample: {"ApplicationDatabaseName": "dazvlpr01xj55a.ap-southeast-2.rds.amazonaws.com"}

return_values.name: stack_parameters
return_values.description: Dictionary of stack parameters keyed by the value of each parameter ‘ParameterKey’ parameter and corresponding value of each parameter ‘ParameterValue’ parameter. Returned: if the stack exists Sample: {"DatabaseEngine": "mysql", "DatabasePassword": "***"}

return_values.name: stack_policy
return_values.description: Describes the stack policy for the stack. Returned: only if all_facts or stack_policy is true and the stack exists

return_values.name: stack_resource_list
return_values.description: Describes stack resources for the stack. Returned: only if all_facts or stack_policy is true and the stack exists

return_values.name: stack_resources
return_values.description: Dictionary of stack resources keyed by the value of each resource ‘LogicalResourceId’ parameter and corresponding value of each resource ‘PhysicalResourceId’ parameter. Returned: only if all_facts or stack_policy is true and the stack exists Sample: {"ApplicationDatabase": "dazvlpr01xj55a", "AutoScalingGroup": "dev-someapp-AutoscalingGroup-1SKEXXBCAN0S7", "AutoScalingSecurityGroup": "sg-abcd1234"}

return_values.name: stack_tags
return_values.description: Dictionary of key value pairs of tags. Returned: only if all_facts or stack_policy is true and the stack exists Sample: {"TagOne": "ValueOne", "TagTwo": "ValueTwo"}

return_values.name: stack_template
return_values.description: Describes the stack template for the stack. Returned: only if all_facts or stack_policy is true and the stack exists
